claims.title: Exact pointwise minimum of the scalar relaxation
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: P_* satisfies S1-S3 and every positive profile satisfying S1-S3 lies pointwise above it.
dependencies: OAI26 scalar assumptions; its h_a recurrence is prior work
claims.limitations: Only the specified scalar relaxation. No actual tensor character realizing P_* is constructed. No priority claim.

claims.title: Compatibility with the rank upper bound
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.limitations: Feasibility at t=3/4 is not a lower bound on the unrestricted matrix multiplication exponent.

claims.title: Compatibility with replication
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: P_*(qa,qb)^3 >= q^4 P_*(a,b)^3 for positive integers q,a,b.
claims.limitations: Does not assert compatibility with every inequality in UZ26.

claims.title: Necessary source length for identical matched sectors
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: A single C(a,B) with three identical C(a,b) targets sharing the a-dimensional input requires B >= 3b+a-1.
claims.limitations: Only the stated identical-sector and single-source class. It does not rule out unequal blocks or tensor-product sources.

claims.title: Product-convolution filtration inequalities
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: The determinant filtration of C(a,b) tensor C(c,d) yields the three stated matched-sector inequality families.
dependencies: OAI26 shared-leg entropy; classical determinant filtration
claims.limitations: Logical independence from the initial scalar system is not proved. No novelty claim for determinant filtration.

claims.title: Uniform tripling gain implies an exponent improvement
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: If every relevant character has a uniform eta>0 gain at all sufficiently large scales, omega <= 9/(4+2 eta).
dependencies: OAI26 spectral conversion and rank bound
claims.limitations: The premise is open. The numerical example 1500/667 is not an established exponent bound.

claims.title: Scalar-profile finite and symbolic checks
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 73,856 exact grid assertions and four symbolic identities pass.
claims.limitations: The finite grid does not prove the general theorem.

claims.title: Finite product-filtration search
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 353,664 inequalities over 20,736 source quadruples with a,b,c,d <=12 produce no violation of P_*.
claims.limitations: No all-size compatibility theorem is established.

claims.title: Finite monomial-weight searches
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 12,976 binary, 209,692 ternary, and 20,000 seeded random candidates produce no scored violation.
claims.limitations: Unknown blocks use a slice lower bound. Random candidates need not be distinct. Floating display rankings are not certificates.

claims.title: All-distribution upper certificate for the optimistic full-filtration score
claims.origin: Codex session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: The explicitly defined full-support entropy score is bounded for every probability distribution by the pointwise rational certificate and by U(a,b,c,d).
claims.limitations: An analytic upper bound, not an asserted weighted block-extraction theorem. Does not prove U is below the matching source at all unequal sizes.

claims.title: Uniform balanced-source gap for the full-filtration entropy score
claims.origin: Codex session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: For every integer n>=2 and every probability distribution on the filtered support of C(n,n)^2, the optimistic entropy score is at most (39/40) P_*(n,n)^2.
dependencies: Exact rational certificates for n=2 through 22
Positive-coefficient polynomial tail certificate for n>=23
claims.limitations: Only the stated balanced family, matching profile and single-filtration score. No general tensor-spectrum barrier or lower bound on omega.

claims.title: Exact whole-simplex upper certificates on the unequal-source grid
claims.origin: Codex session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: All 20,736 source quadruples with lengths 1 through 12 pass exact upper certificates bounding every probability distribution of the optimistic full-filtration score.
dependencies: Rational enclosures computed with integer square roots
claims.limitations: Finite source grid. No all-size unequal-source theorem or exponent improvement follows.

claims.title: Determinant-divisor obstruction for arbitrary group-algebra degenerations
claims.statement: If C[G] degenerates to M(n,n,p), each irrep degree d>N-np must be divisible by n. Three small affine-group candidates violate this necessary condition.
claims.limitations: Necessary condition only. Does not exclude the three SL(2,5) target shapes. Written proof has no independent review or formalization.

claims.title: Exact central-idempotent certificate for SL(2,5) source degrees
claims.statement: Nine nonzero central idempotents over Q(sqrt(5)) are orthogonal, sum to one and have regular ranks equal to the squares of 1,2,2,3,3,4,4,5,6.
claims.limitations: Source certificate only; not a matrix-tensor target degeneration.

claims.title: Conditional exact gate at exponent 2249/1000
claims.statement: Each proposed SL(2,5) target of shapes (9,9,12), (9,10,11), (10,10,10), if constructed as a degeneration, implies omega <=2249/1000 by the certified strict degree-sum inequality.
dependencies: Asymptotic sum inequality and border conversion
claims.limitations: The displayed numerical bound is conditional and is not established.

claims.title: Bounded exact-potential searches and replayed Farkas cuts
claims.statement: A small (3,3,3) control degeneration verifies exactly; 479 learned Farkas cuts replay exactly across the (6,6,6) control and C5:C4 candidate run. Record-target searches have no successful witness.
dependencies: Exact group products and integer potential verification
claims.limitations: Timeouts and SAT UNSAT results without proof traces are not independently certified exclusions. No record improvement.
